bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format 'GAYBBS_RUNNING={{.State.Running}}'
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'if [ "${GAYBBS_ROOM_EVENT_WORKER_ENABLED:-}" = enabled ]; then echo ROOM_EVENT_WORKER=ENABLED; else echo ROOM_EVENT_WORKER=NOT_ENABLED; fi; if [ "${GAYBBS_ROOM_STATUS_EDIT_ENABLED:-}" = enabled ]; then echo ROOM_PUBLIC_STATUS_EDIT=ENABLED; else echo ROOM_PUBLIC_STATUS_EDIT=NOT_ENABLED; fi'
test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 71
echo RUNTIME_RELEASE_FLAGS_READBACK_PASS
